name: write-tab-inherits-bullet
request: Rewrite the tab from markdown: a heading and two plain paragraphs.
command:
sh -c "printf '# New title

First paragraph.

Second paragraph.
' > /tmp/gdt-micro-write.md && gdoc write --force --quiet --account {A} --tab '{TAB}' {DOC} /tmp/gdt-micro-write.md"
expected: Tab holds exactly: HEADING_1 `New title`, then two NORMAL_TEXT paragraphs with no bullets.
target: heading `New title`, paragraph beginning `First paragraph`, paragraph beginning `Second paragraph`
allowed: revision list grows; renumber; lists map
explain: The tab has an intro paragraph and a two-item bulleted list. We asked gdoc to replace the whole tab with new content written in Markdown: a title and two plain paragraphs, no list. The new text is there, but the paragraphs still carry a bullet from the old list, and empty paragraphs appeared. This is the behaviour reported in gdoc issue 59. Look at the after tab: the paragraphs that should be plain have bullets in front of them.
